title: Branson Jet Boats
specs: High speed bow dunks, 360 spins, and power slides on Lake Taneycomo
Scenic 12+ mile round trip on Lake Taneycomo
Unique thrill adventure powered by three 400 HP engines
All passengers must sign an Adventure Agreement before boarding
Children under 12 not allowed to sit on outside of rows
All front row passengers must be at least 48 inches tall
Children under 7 must wear a PFD at all times
Guests with health conditions should consult a physician before riding
All guests must be able to transfer into and out of the boat
includes: Guided tour with history and local stories
Life jackets provided for children under 7
blurb: Guests take a one hour, twelve mile round trip jet boat tour on Lake Taneycomo featuring high speed bow dunks, 360 spins, and power slides. The tour includes history and local stories with natural scenery. All passengers must sign an Adventure Agreement before boarding.
extraNote: Contact by phone to cancel or inquire about cancellation · Late arrivals may miss the tour and are non-refundable · Heavy rain and lightning may delay the ride · Ticket kiosk at Branson Landing near Joe’s Crab Shack and Saltgrass Steakhouse, on Lake Taneycomo
